read: the close fell 11.12% from saturday 7 november to saturday 14 november, after falling 8.90% the week before, the third falling week in a row. it sits 23.63% below the 50 week average, after 15.54% below it a week earlier, the widest gap under that line in eleven weeks, since the week to 29 august 2026. hashrate read 343.29 PH/s on saturday 14 november and averaged 328.45 PH/s from 8 to 14 november, against 356.11 PH/s from 1 to 7 november, in our own daily log.
